title: How a Crash Into a Cruise Ship in New Orleans Became a ‘Miracle on the Mississippi’
summary: When a 525-foot tanker struck the docked American Heritage riverboat on Nov. 13, a rescue operation turned tragedy into triumph and led the nearly 200 aboard to safety.
